$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the General section's Agent Chat defaults for new chats (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: agentDefaults
lists.note: The defaults a new agent chat starts with (Agents > Agent Chat).

rows.name: permissionMode
rows.note: acpmux reads it at each new chat (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/start_mode.rs): a mode picked in a chat applies to that chat only (Leo 2026-10-21). A value MDM or the team policy forces reaches acpmux through the app's settings push (ChatSettings) and wins over the settings file.

help.text: What a new chat may do without asking. A mode you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

rows.note: How long Claude Code keeps a chat's prompt cached. acpmux reads it at each Claude Code start (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/prompt_cache_env.rs).

help.text: How long Claude Code keeps a chat's prompt cached. One hour keeps replies after a pause cheap; its cache writes cost a little more.

rows.name: modelRouterModel
rows.note: The model the cmux model router profile (cmux) starts new chats on; acpmux reads it when it builds that profile (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/config/discover.rs add_cmux_router). The choices are the router's DeepSeek models, default first (user 2026-10-28: DeepSeek only, the 10/17 build with images by default); CMUX_ROUTER_MODELS in acpmux and the backend allowlist (INFERENCE_MODEL_ALLOWLIST) hold the same list.

help.text: The model a new chat on the cmux model router starts on. A model you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

lists.name: agentTools

group.text: cmux Tools in Your Coding Agents

lists.note: Settings > Agents > cmux Tools in Your Coding Agents: the onboarding step's question (may cmux add its MCP server to the person's coding agents?) and its answer, beside the card that adds or removes the server now.

rows.name: cmuxMcp
rows.note: Whether cmux adds its cmux MCP server (cmux mcp serve, which carries cmux Computer Use) to the person's own coding agents, Claude Code and Codex: both the server the claude and codex shims pass to an agent started in a cmux terminal (cmux-tui agent_mcp_choice.rs) and the entries cmux setup mcp writes into the agents' config files (cli/setup/mcp.rs). ask (unset) keeps what cmux did before the onboarding step asked; on is the person's opt-in (it also turns the server on for these agents unless mcp.enabled says otherwise, cli/mcp/config.rs); off passes and writes nothing. cmux's own agent chats keep their tools either way. Rust reads it with cmux_tui_core::user_settings::AgentsCmuxMcp.

title.text: Add cmux Tools to Your Coding Agents

help.text: Lets Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents you run use cmux's tools, Computer Use included. Ask keeps adding them to agents you start in a cmux terminal until you choose. Off adds nothing and leaves your agents' settings alone.

summary.text: Whether your coding agents get cmux's tools
